specs.title: Public booking flow
specs.why: This is the revenue path: without it the product has no customer-facing function.
specs.scope: Multi-step booking at `/{slug}/book` creating a pending booking and holding the slot for 10 minutes.
tasks: Add `lib/slot-hold.ts`: implement the hold with a 10-minute expiry
acceptance: A completed flow creates a booking with status `pending_payment`, verified by `pnpm test`
A second session requesting the held slot receives HTTP 409

specs.title: Booking confirmation and notification stub
specs.why: Customers need proof of booking, and the domain event is the seam later notification work plugs into.
specs.scope: Confirmation screen with an `.ics` download and signed reschedule and cancel links.
acceptance: The generated file from `lib/ics.ts` imports into Google Calendar, verified by `pnpm test`
